records.text: Harry Myers said that in the days after the tunnel bust, his information was given to the cartels before U.S. authorities received the Mexican-side photographs.
records.speaker: Harry Myers

appearances.snippet: Somehow, in the immediate days after the bust, prior to the United States side getting the photos from the Mexican authorities, my information was given to the cartels.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows Owens reading this as Harry Myers' first-person allegation. Current searches for Myers, Operation Catacomb, the Douglas tunnel aftermath, cartel leaks, and contemporaneous government or press records found only later recirculations of Owens' episode, not an incident record, authenticated photographs, official investigation, or independent witness establishing that Myers' information reached a cartel before U.S. authorities received Mexican-side photographs. The allegation is not contradicted by the absence of public records, but it cannot be verified from available evidence.

records.text: Harry Myers said he helped pinpoint the sophisticated cross-border drug tunnel discovered at Douglas, Arizona, in 1990 during Operation Catacomb
records.speaker: Harry Myers

appearances.snippet: In just six days I planted sensors, translated data, and skipped the chain of command and gave proof of the existence and pinpointed the location of the first ever discovered Sinaloa cartel underground rail tunnel

verification.notes: Contemporaneous reporting confirms the central event: JTF-6 military geologists used advanced seismic equipment to detect the sophisticated Douglas cross-border tunnel in 1990. The source does not identify Harry Myers, use the name Operation Catacomb, establish a six-day solo discovery, or call it the first-ever Sinaloa rail tunnel. The revised statement presents Myers role as his quoted account and narrows the public fact to what the record supports.

sources.title: $1-Million Drug Tunnel Found at Mexico Border
sources.relevance: Contemporaneous reporting confirms the 1990 Douglas tunnel and says a JTF-6 military geology team using seismic equipment detected it, but does not name Myers or Operation Catacomb.

records.text: Harry Myers said a cartel member in Naco confirmed his identity by reciting personal details from his military clearance packet, which was supposed to be held by the Joint Task Force Six commander.
records.speaker: Harry Myers

appearances.snippet: In continuing the mission, me and one Border Patrol agent were sent to Naco, Arizona, where I was approached by a cartel member confirming my identification by rattling off my mother's name, address, my high school, my friends, everything listed in my clearance packet, which was supposed to be locked in custody, in the custody of the Joint Task Force Six commander.

verification.notes: Transcript context shows Owens reading Myers' account that a cartel member in Naco recited private details from his clearance packet. Current searches for Myers, Joint Task Force Six, Naco, the claimed clearance packet, and cartel contact found no authenticated packet, contemporaneous report, named witness, court filing, or independent account. Public episode summaries repeat the allegation but do not independently corroborate it. Missing public evidence is not a contradiction, so the claim remains unverifiable.
